name: Bean-to-Bar Chocolate Making & Tasting
tagline: See, smell and taste your way from raw Indian cacao to a finished bar.
description: A hands-on tour of the Darkins micro-factory. Handle cocoa beans from different regions of India, watch roasting, winnowing, grinding and tempering happen in front of you, then sit down for a guided tasting of six chocolates — with a charcuterie board of nibbles and in-house spreads to finish.

itinerary.title: Introduction to chocolate
itinerary.detail: The history of chocolate, cacao in India, and how a bar actually gets made.

itinerary.title: Factory tour
itinerary.detail: Bean storage, roasting, cracking and winnowing, grinding and conching — and a live tempering of a full batch.

itinerary.title: Guided tasting
itinerary.detail: Six chocolate samples, tasted slowly and properly.

itinerary.title: Q&A + nibbles
itinerary.detail: Ask the makers anything, over a charcuterie board with in-house spreads.

venue: Darkins Studio, 2nd Floor, B-108, Pocket B, Okhla Phase I, New Delhi 110020
